visual_concept: Premium internal lab dashboard. Apple-like polish. Subtle futuristic aesthetic. Dark graphite/black base. Subtle green/cyan accents. Clean typography. Smooth animations. High-end spacing. Modern cards. Beautiful detail pages.

components_shadcn_customization.Card: bg-[#121215] border border-[#27272A] shadow-none rounded-xl overflow-hidden hover:border-[#3f3f46] transition-colors duration-300. Use p-6 or p-8 for generous spacing.
components_shadcn_customization.Button: Primary: bg-[#FAFAFA] text-[#0A0A0C] hover:bg-[#E4E4E7]. Secondary: bg-[#1A1A1E] text-white border border-[#27272A] hover:bg-[#27272A]. Destructive: bg-red-500/10 text-red-500 hover:bg-red-500/20 border border-red-500/20.
components_shadcn_customization.Badge: Rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] or text-xs font-mono font-medium. High contrast inner borders. See Status Badges section.
components_shadcn_customization.Input_Select: bg-[#121215] border border-[#27272A] focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-[#34D399] rounded-lg h-10 text-sm
components_shadcn_customization.Tabs: TabsList bg-[#1A1A1E] p-1 rounded-lg border border-[#27272A]/50. TabsTrigger data-[state=active]:bg-[#27272A] data-[state=active]:text-white text-zinc-400 rounded-md transition-all duration-200
components_shadcn_customization.Dialog: bg-[#121215] border border-[#27272A] sm:rounded-2xl shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-sm
components_shadcn_customization.Table: border-collapse. Header text-xs font-mono text-zinc-500. Row hover bg-[#17171A]. Last item of grid without border.

layout_patterns.navigation: Left sidebar (w-64) with fixed positioning. Subtle active states (bg-[#1A1A1E] text-white). Top global search bar header (Command-palette style, backdrop-blur-md, border-b border-[#27272A]). Dashboard content area max-w-7xl mx-auto py-8.
layout_patterns.spacing: Generous spacing philosophy. p-6 or p-8 for inner card padding. gap-6 or gap-8 for CSS grids.
layout_patterns.bento_grid: Dashboard layout: 1/4 width stat cards on top row. 2/3 and 1/3 splits for charts and feeds. Heights perfectly aligned (h-full).
layout_patterns.detail_pages: Large sticky header with Job ID (Mono), Title, Actions (right), and Badges. robust Tabs component below header.

page_wireframes.Login: Full viewport. Left side dark graphite login form, minimalist fields. Right side abstract dark/cyan subtle image. Glowing accent on submit button.
page_wireframes.Dashboard: KPI stat widgets (Active, Completed, Revenue). Middle: Revenue Chart (Recharts, customized with dark grid lines, cyan stroke). Right: Recent activity vertical timeline.
page_wireframes.Jobs: List view: Data table with sticky header, mono fonts for Job ID, rich status badges. Detail view: Heavy use of tabs (Overview, Timeline, Checklist, Files, Gallery, Device, Client, Finance, Secrets, Notes).
page_wireframes.New_Edit_Job: Dynamic template selector using large cards (12+ templates like Custom PC Build, PC Repair). Selecting template updates form fields contextually.
page_wireframes.Clients: Table list. Detail page aggregates all jobs/revenue for client.
page_wireframes.Devices_Assets: Specs sheet look using mono font for SN/MAC.
page_wireframes.Finance: Bar charts for revenue breakdown. List of unpaid jobs.
page_wireframes.Settings: Brand configs, password change, etc. Clean lists.

specific_ui_treatments.timeline_entry: Vertical line on left (border-l-2 border-zinc-800). Dot indicating entry type (Green for Payment, Blue for Diagnosis). JetBrains Mono for timestamps.
specific_ui_treatments.secrets_field: Password/API keys wrapped in blur-md text filter by default. Reveal on hover/click icon. Includes click-to-copy.
specific_ui_treatments.empty_states: Minimalist Lucide icon in center (opacity 40), text-zinc-500, dashed border wrapper p-12. No childish illustrations. Highly technical/sterile.

login_background.description: Dark modern empty desk for login background or atmospheric headers

testing.requirements: All interactive elements, buttons, inputs, tabs, and critical text MUST have data-testid attributes formatted in kebab-case.
